_comment: CCS-19 — the dead-collector backstop. Every collector cycle writes exactly one doc_type:run heartbeat; when none arrives inside the window, the collector is dead, the host is down, or its credential has expired — and every other rule in this project has gone quiet for the wrong reason. Not grouped: there is only one collector. The window must be comfortably wider than the cron interval (setup_alerting.py defaults it to 3x).
